\noindent\footnotesize Peak GPU memory 1.7 GB; model load 9.1 s, once. Rows are per-stage medians and do not sum to the total row, which is the median of the whole. Image and impulse-response reads come from network storage. Scoring here covers every cell of the grid, which is what the analysis pipeline does to draw the maps; the rule itself needs only the cells inside its ten half-metre discs, about 800, which the main repository timed at 1.6 ms.

\begin{table}[t]\centering\small
\caption{What the acoustic branch could replace. Each visual backbone is a frozen image encoder, a trained head that turns its features into rays, and a non-learned match of those rays against the floorplan. Sound can stand in only for the last two, and they are a few percent of the parameters and of the time; the encoder is the cost. Dropping them also drops the hypotheses the acoustic branch ranks, and sound alone reaches $36.0\%$ at 1\,m against $60.0\%$ fused (UnLoc, Replica, final protocol). Times are medians over the three scenes, milliseconds. UnLoc's checkpoint also carries a 31\,M-parameter depth head that inference never calls.}
